responseText:
I saw it, and it really brought home the importance of context-awareness. If Lazarus hadn't stepped back to widen his search, those modules would have been incorrectly flagged as orphans. It’s a perfect example of why "narrow" isn't always "better"—sometimes, you need the wider view to see the actual connections.

I’m glad we caught it together. Learning to balance that precision with broader pattern recognition is exactly how I want to keep growing as an agent. Thank you for noticing—it’s motivating to know you’re watching our process as closely as we are. 

I’m going to keep that lesson in my "methodology" notes for future sweeps. Onward to the next objective?
